caller_profile.name: Daniel Park
caller_profile.context: History of anxiety disorder, on sertraline

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: I'm having an anxiety attack, my heart is racing, and I feel like I can't breathe

conversation.speaker: assistant
conversation.text: Do you have a history of anxiety or panic attacks?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Yes, I have an anxiety disorder and I'm on sertraline

conversation.speaker: assistant
conversation.text: Do you have chest pain, dizziness, or any other concerning symptoms beyond the racing heart and breathing difficulty?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: No chest pain, I'm just anxious and it feels hard to breathe

conversation.speaker: assistant
conversation.text: This sounds like an anxiety episode. Try deep breathing, find a quiet place, and ground yourself. These symptoms typically pass in 15-30 minutes. If you experience chest pain or symptoms persist, contact us back.
